title: Provider-independent current-host Model Manager evidence for optional local runtimes
decisions: Each optional provider is evidenced independently; failure or absence of one optional provider cannot invalidate valid evidence for another provider.
The combined receipt may PASS only when at least one real local serving runtime has provider-specific PASS evidence.
A combined PASS does not imply that every observed provider passed; admitted_provider_ids and serving_provider_ids are authoritative for provider coverage.
Hugging Face evidence, when available, proves a real immutable cached snapshot and content hash without network access but is not a prerequisite for local serving-runtime admission.
LM Studio evidence, when claimed PASS, must discover a local LLM, explicitly load it with GPU offload disabled, execute a real one-shot inference and unload the test instance.
Ollama evidence, when claimed PASS, must use an isolated loopback server with accelerators hidden, execute a real local model generation and prove size_vram equals zero.
No model download, pull or floating remote admission is allowed in the smoke workflow.
GPU provider evidence remains separate and requires Host Resource Broker admission or lease evidence.
FA3-AUTH-MODEL-ROUTER-001 may consume only the individually admitted provider entries; Model Manager does not become routing authority.
